interface.name: cutefish_window_hints_v1
interface.description: Clients may set hints only on their own surfaces. Hints are immediate metadata, independent of wl_surface.commit, and persist until replaced or the surface is destroyed. Destroying the manager does not reset them. Set initial hints before the first buffer commit to avoid task-list flashes. These hints grant no focus or privileged shell role.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: a value is out of range

request.name: set_skip_taskbar

description.summary: exclude a surface from application presentation

request.description: A value of 1 excludes the window from the dock and window switcher and preserves the previous status bar application context when focused. A value of 0 restores normal policy and is the default. Keyboard focus and input are unaffected. The compositor may also exclude windows by role.

request.name: set_always_on_top

description.summary: keep a window above ordinary application windows

request.description: A value of 1 stacks the window above ordinary application windows, and still below the shell's panels, dock and system dialogs. A value of 0 restores normal stacking and is the default. Only application windows are affected; activation and focus are unchanged.

request.name: set_resize_anchor

description.summary: choose the point a client resize keeps in place

request.description: When the client changes the size of a normal window on its own, with a new buffer or window geometry rather than in answer to a configure, the compositor keeps this point of the window where it was and then keeps the window inside the work area. Resizes the compositor initiates, interactive resizes and maximized, fullscreen or tiled windows are unaffected. top_left is the default.
